# IC 342: The Hidden Galaxy Revealed

Peering through the thick cosmic fog of our own Milky Way's gas and dust, astronomers have captured this stunning spiral galaxy IC 342, lurking just 10 million light-years away and ranking among the brightest galaxies in its neighborhood. The galaxy's patchy dark lanes reveal where dust is blocking the glow of hydrogen gas around brilliant young stars, while mysterious magnetic fields crisscrossing its spiral arms may hold the key to understanding how these elegant cosmic spirals actually form.
